description: Single multi-purpose correction row applied to combat damage multipliers, cursed-energy experience and movement/action rigidity rates; its first row is cached by the data-table manager and sampled by characters and status controllers.

ID.technical: FName Id (constructed default NAME_None); the only exported row is named Default. Consumers do not look the row up by this member: AGameDataTableManager::FindGlobalCorrectRow calls FirstGlobalCorrectRow(GlobalCorrectDataTables), which reads the first row name of the first non-empty table and FindRow<FGameDataTableRow_GlobalCorrect> on it. No traced C++ reads Id itself.

SuperArmor_Damage.simple: Damage multiplier while super armor absorbs a hit.
SuperArmor_Damage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies the accumulated receive-damage rate by it only when IsHitBlockedBySuperArmor(DamageRow) is true; it is independent of bIgnoreComboCorrect and is applied after the combo, action, tag-combo and casual multipliers.

HyperArmor_Damage.simple: Damage multiplier while hyper armor absorbs a hit.
HyperArmor_Damage.technical: float, default 0.0f in the constructor; exported Default value 0.5. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies the accumulated rate by it only when IsHitBlockedByHyperArmor(DamageRow) is true, after the super-armor branch.

TagCombo_DownDamage.simple: Down-damage-rate override installed at the start of tag-combo damage actions.
TagCombo_DownDamage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. Five tag-combo action starts read it via FindGlobalCorrectRow and pass it to StatusController->SetDownDamageRate (row member +0x18), then set an unlimited collision lock 4: TagComboDamage, TagComboDamageBlow, TagComboProjectionSorceryReceive, TagComboProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow and the restraint tag-combo variant. Down-damage rate is consumed by AGameCharacter::GetDownDamageRate.

Combo_Base.simple: Base of the exponential received-damage combo scaling.
Combo_Base.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate computes max(Combo_Base ^ ComboCount, Combo_Min) when DamageRow->bIgnoreComboCorrect is false. ComboCount is GAISlot056 when Flag==1, otherwise GetReceivedComboCount(); the result multiplies the incoming damage rate.

Combo_Min.simple: Lower bound of the received-damage combo scaling.
Combo_Min.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.6. Used as the second argument of FMath::Max in AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate, flooring Combo_Base ^ ComboCount whenever the damage row does not ignore combo correction.

Combo_Damage.simple: Damage-combo multiplier for ordinary/receive damage actions.
Combo_Damage.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. Returned by FGameCharacterAction_Damage::GetDamageComboRate, FGameCharacterAction_ProjectionSorceryReceive::GetDamageComboRate, FGameCharacterAction_CrimsonBindingRestraint::GetDamageComboRate, FGameCharacterAction_CentipedeRestraint::GetDamageComboRate and FGameCharacterAction_FreezingRestraint::GetDamageComboRate (all retail 0x14109C280). The action controller's damage-combo rate is then multiplied into AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate when the damage row does not ignore damage-action correction or a technique-damage correction applies.

Combo_Blow.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_Blow::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C1F0) returns row member +0x28; the value enters the action-controller damage-combo multiplier used by received-damage calculation.

Combo_BlowSmall.simple: Damage-combo multiplier for small blow actions.
Combo_BlowSmall.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSmall::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C250) returns row member +0x2C for the action-controller damage-combo multiplier.

Combo_BlowLarge.simple: Damage-combo multiplier for large blow actions.
Combo_BlowLarge.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_BlowLarge::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C220) returns row member +0x30 for the action-controller damage-combo multiplier.

Combo_Down.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.9. FGameCharacterAction_Down::GetDamageComboRate (retail 0x14109C2B0) returns row member +0x34 for the action-controller damage-combo multiplier.

Combo_TagCombo.simple: Damage multiplier applied during tag combos.
Combo_TagCombo.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 0.85. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies by it when ActionController->bTagComboDamageAction == 1, independently of the bIgnoreComboCorrect flag.

Combo_Casual.simple: Damage multiplier for casual damage actions.
Combo_Casual.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. AGameCharacter::GetReceivedDamageRate multiplies by it when bCancelCasualDamageActionCorrect is false and ActionController->bCasualDamageAction == 1.

ComboDown_Casual.simple: Casual-attack multiplier on the down damage rate.
ComboDown_Casual.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. AGameCharacter::GetDownDamageRate multiplies StatusController down rate x ActionController slot 108 by it when the attack type is neither CursedEnergyAttack_1 nor CursedEnergyAttack_2, bCancelCasualDamageActionCorrect is false and ActionController->bCasualDamageAction == 1.

CursedEnergyExp_Base.simple: Per-stock-difference slope for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExp_Base.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value -0.1. AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate computes StockRate = (OwnStock - receiver stock) * Base + 1.0f, where stocks come from AGameBattleManager::GetCharacterStock for the attacker's and receiver's teams, then clamps StockRate to [CursedEnergyExp_Min, CursedEnergyExp_Max].

CursedEnergyExp_Max.simple: Upper clamp for the stock-based cursed-energy experience rate.
CursedEnergyExp_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.2. Passed as the max argument of FMath::Clamp on StockRate in AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate, together with CursedEnergyExp_Min.

CursedEnergyExp_Min.simple: Lower clamp for the stock-based cursed-energy experience rate.
CursedEnergyExp_Min.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value 1.0. Passed as the min argument of FMath::Clamp on StockRate in AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate, together with CursedEnergyExp_Max.

CursedEnergyExp_Level.simple: Per-level-difference slope for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExp_Level.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported Default value -0.05. AGameCharacter::GetCursedEnergyExpRate computes Rate = (LevelDifference * Level + 1.0f) * (StockRate * TeamRate), where LevelDifference is Receiver->GetCursedEnergyLevelDifference(attacker's clamped level) and TeamRate comes from the battle manager. Buff/debuff records from the receiver that name this attacker are then multiplied in.

Rigidity_JumpBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers indexed by the jump-start animation type.
Rigidity_JumpBegin.technical: TArray<float>, constructor leaves it empty; exported Default values [0.8, 0.7, 0.6]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetJumpBeginRigidityRate selects the element with GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Owner->GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_JumpBegin); that helper returns enum value - 1, so None maps to -1, Light/Normal/Heavy to 0/1/2. Invalid/out-of-range values fall back to 1.0f. BuffDebuff float corrections are not applied in this getter.

Rigidity_RunJumpBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for running jump starts.
Rigidity_RunJumpBegin.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [0.8, 0.7, 0.6]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetRunJumpBeginRigidityRate looks up GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_RunJumpBegin through Status_RigidityRate (enum - 1, range-checked, default 1.0f).

Rigidity_DashJumpBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for dash jump starts.
Rigidity_DashJumpBegin.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [0.75, 0.7, 0.65]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashJumpBeginRigidityRate indexes it with GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_DashJumpBegin (enum - 1); out-of-range yields 1.0f.

Rigidity_JumpAirBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for aerial jump starts.
Rigidity_JumpAirBegin.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetJumpAirBeginRigidityRate indexes it with GetActionJumpRow()->Rigidity_JumpAirBegin (enum - 1, range-checked; fallback 1.0f).

Rigidity_DashBegin.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [1.0, 0.9, 0.8]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashBeginRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, replaces it with the element selected by GameActionRigidity_ToIndex(current dash row Rigidity_DashBegin) when in range, then applies each CP_010_Passive buff as Rate += FloatValue[1] - 1.0f.

Rigidity_DashEnd.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [1.0, 0.92, 0.88]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashEndRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, selects by current dash row Rigidity_DashEnd (enum - 1, in-range only), then adds CP_010_Passive FloatValue[1] and CP_240_Passive FloatValue[2] corrections (each minus 1.0f) and clamps the result to at least 0.0f.

Rigidity_DashAirBegin.simple: Rigidity multipliers for aerial dash starts.
Rigidity_DashAirBegin.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [1.0, 0.925, 0.9]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashAirBeginRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, selects by current dash row Rigidity_DashAirBegin (enum - 1, in-range only), then applies CP_010_Passive FloatValue[1] - 1.0f.

Rigidity_DashAirEnd.simple: Rigidity multipliers for aerial dash ends.
Rigidity_DashAirEnd.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetDashAirEndRigidityRate starts at 1.0f, selects by current dash row Rigidity_DashAirEnd (enum - 1, in-range only), then applies CP_010_Passive FloatValue[1] and CP_240_Passive FloatValue[2] corrections (each minus 1.0f).

Rigidity_Landing.technical: TArray<float>; exported Default values [1.1, 1.0, 0.9]. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetLandingRigidityRate indexes it with GetCurrentActionMoveRow()->Rigidity_Landing through Status_RigidityRate (enum - 1, in-range only, otherwise 1.0f).

notes: The retail asset has one row (Default) with the export ImportKeyField Id; the reconstructed row struct is FGameDataTableRow_GlobalCorrect in /Script/AbramsDataTable. AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves GlobalCorrectDataTable into GlobalCorrectDataTables (+0x2F0), and FindGlobalCorrectRow/FirstGlobalCorrectRow always take the first row of the first table whose row names are non-empty. No consumer was found that selects a different row by Id.

The name Combo_* members are ours; retail comments in the reconstructed source preserve the member offsets (row +0x18 TagCombo_DownDamage, +0x24 Combo_Damage, +0x28 Combo_Blow, +0x2C Combo_BlowSmall, +0x30 Combo_BlowLarge, +0x34 Combo_Down, +0xD8 Rigidity_Landing). They are static evidence, not claims of retail-readable source names.

Rigidity arrays are indexed by EGameActionRigidityType minus one (None=-1, Invalid=254); out-of-range reads return 1.0f. This mapping is shared with other animation-notification enum tables via GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex.

No exported row other than Default and no runtime/Blueprint variation was observed. Static reconstructed C++ plus the supplied export were the only inputs; uninspected content or Blueprint uses cannot be excluded.

usages.detail: Resolves the loaded GlobalCorrectDataTable asset into GlobalCorrectDataTables once all loaders complete.
FirstGlobalCorrectRow returns the first row of the first non-empty table; FindGlobalCorrectRow wraps it and is called by all traced consumers.
GetCursedEnergyExpRate applies the stock and level slopes and clamps to build the receiver's cursed-energy experience rate.
GetDownDamageRate applies ComboDown_Casual for non-cursed-energy casual attacks.
GetReceivedDamageRate applies combo, tag-combo, casual, super-armor and hyper-armor corrections in sequence.
Damage, projection-sorcery and restraint action GetDamageComboRate overrides return Combo_Damage for the action-controller multiplier.
Blow, Down, BlowSmall and BlowLarge action overrides return their respective Combo_* values.
Tag-combo damage action Start installs TagCombo_DownDamage as the victim's down damage rate.
Dash rigidity rate getters map the current action row's rigidity enum to an array index, then layer CP_010/CP_240 buff corrections.
Status_RigidityRate performs the shared range-checked array lookup with a 1.0f fallback for jump, run-jump, dash-jump, air-jump and landing rates.
